text:
raj (Sales): FYI — Aurora (pilot) just emailed their SRE/infra lead, wants a 3-week pilot. They asked for what we need for POC + a short list of security artifacts. Can we draft?
anya (Solutions): Great — can you paste their core use cases? That'll affect model choice and success metrics.
raj (Sales): Use cases: 1) customer support triage (classification + rerank), 2) short-form summarization of tickets, 3) embeddings for search. Volume: ~50k msgs/day during pilot.
leo (Security): For POC we should proactively provide: DPA draft, SOC2 Type II summary (redacted), encryption at rest diagram, KMS integration notes, and pen-test scope/expectations. If they require HIPAA/GDPR handling we'll need dataflow mapping.
sofia (Legal): DPA: we can send our standard DPA template. Turnaround: legal needs ~3 business days to get countersigned once they return edits. Confirm who the signatory is on their side.
anya (Solutions): Proposed acceptance criteria (suggestion):
- classification F1 >= 0.82 on their eval set
- summarization ROUGE-L > baseline by 10%
- embeddings recall@10 >= 0.75
- latency p95 < 250ms for single-request path
- stable run for 48h with <1% error rate
raj (Sales): They also asked about pricing for pilot and whether we can limit data residency to eu-west. Any blockers?
leo (Security): Data residency: Hosted in eu-west region is fine for pilot. For stricter residency (on-prem/VPC) we'd route to Redwood Private — that changes cost and timeline.
sofia (Legal): If PHI is in scope (HIPAA), we need a BAA. We don't sign BAAs on standard trials; escalate to AE+legal for enterprise pilots.
leo (Security): Pen-test asks: they want to run a light external penetration test against the pilot endpoints. We require a short window and a test plan. Recommended flow:
```
- customer shares test plan + IPs
- agree blackout windows (no heavy load during busy hours)
- Redwood sec point-of-contact monitors
- findings shared, triage within 5 business days
```
raj (Sales): Good — can sec team provide a one-pager we can send that outlines what we can/can't allow?
leo (Security): I'll drop a one-pager and a minimal SOC2 extract. Also note: if they request raw request logs, we need explicit approval; otherwise provide aggregated metrics and samples with obfuscation.
anya (Solutions): For the evals: ask Aurora to send a small labeled subset (500 examples) and an unlabeled stream for latency testing. We'll run model variants and return a short eval report.
sec-bot: checklist created: [DPA, SOC2-extract, encryption-diagram, KMS-integration, pen-test-guidelines] — tag @leo (Security) to attach files.
sofia (Legal): Also flag IP terms: who owns prompt-derived artifacts? Default is customer owns data/outputs, but clarify in DPA/POC SOW.
raj (Sales): Timeline suggestion: this week — share docs; next week — get their labeled evals; week after — run pilot. Can we hit that?
anya (Solutions): Yes if we get eval set by Mon. I'll prep the model run plan today.
leo (Security): I'll compile docs and pen-test one-pager by EOD.
sofia (Legal): I'll queue the DPA for review. If they need BAA we escalate.
raj (Sales): I'll coordinate with Aurora and book a quick alignment call tomorrow. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
anya (Solutions): Also adding a simple cost estimate: hosted pilot ~ $1.2k/week for the stated volume; Private will be higher — I'll formalize in the call.
raj (Sales): Perfect. I'll update the customer and ping once they confirm the labeled dataset.
